# Which jobs make your phone repair shop money, and how many does the season have to sell?

> Free phone repair shop calculator: enter screen, port and micro-soldering prices, bench minutes, supplies, technician pay and rent, and see profit per job and per bench hour, break-even volume and the season result. Runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
